reviews.x: Great product! I was a little skeptical at first ( his was a gift from my wife) but after my first try I was sold! Heated up quickly and didn't make any of the smell that you sometimes get with new appliances when they heat up. Makes my beard look longer and shinier and the straightening lasts a full day, sometimes more if you use a beard oil with it.

reviews.t: Not sure how I lived without one of these before
reviews.x: Funny story. I randomly bumped into some guy at a networking party and thought he had a sharp hairstyle. I asked him if his hair was naturally straight or how he gets it to  be so straight. He began telling me about some beard brush that works like a women's straightening iron, except this one's for men. I decided to look up beard straighteners on Amazon and basically chose this one based on its reviews. Anyway, I cannot believe that I've never knew these existed. It's compact, easy to pack for

It's a good basic beard/hair straightener.  I have a scraggly beard, and this seems to keep it from going in all directions.  It's lightweight, and doesn't take too long to warm up.  Usually, I plug it in, turn it on, and brush my teeth.  In about 2 1/2 minutes, it's all ready to go.
This is perfect for men. Just be careful on the edge. If you tilt it to far you can burn your self while doing the mustache.
I bought this for my husband and he really likes it. And not gonna lie, I do to. No more looking at a untamed mess of a man. Lol!

Heats up quickly and definitely gets hot enough for effective use. The only con was that the teeth of the brush aren't very long so it wasn't as effective as my boyfriend would like for his beard. It's more suited for shorter beards and hair. He still likes it but will use it more when he decides to go shorter in length.

reviews.t: It kept him from shaving it off.
reviews.x: My husband is a man of few words, so when I asked him what he thought of it and he said, "Yeah, works.  I use it," I knew it was a pretty good product.  He was going to shave it off and I begged him to wait and let me get him something to try to make it better, and he apparently likes the results because he still has the beard and the straightener brush.   It's small as a hairbrush.  It's not a blow dryer type- no "blow," just a heated brush to tame unruly hair.  Unless it stops working (in whic

This thing works. I use it on my beard. My beard is quite worry and I usually use a blow dryer to tame it. This thing takes it to a whole new level. Probably adds another inch to length once straitened. It makes my beard a lot softer as well.

I never thought in a million years it would work. My boyfriend's beard is so thick and curly (imagine a pot scratcher attached to a head) but surprisingly it makes it as smooth and straight as my flat iron does my hair! Now if anyone can please convince him to trim it, that'd be great, he currently looks like Gandalf from Lord of the Rings

I combed out my beard with this thing very carefully. I took a long time and went over it several times. It looked a little better when i was through, but not a lot. I will try it a few more times, but if you are looking for a dramatic difference (like in the pictures that go with the ad for this thing), you might not see it.

Mind you, he's only used it a handful of times, but so far it works how it's supposed to and super easy to use. Doesn't take long to heat up, straightens beard with a few slow comb throughs, and it holds the shape of beard well. Sheerness, is nice. He also burned himself but that's to be expected when joking around.

It gets hot and it does some straightening, but it's a waste of time. The results are less than mediocre and you would still need to use a different tool to get the expected results. It would be much quicker to just use a hair dryer. It underperformed in my opinion

I don’t use this as a beard straightener. I use it for quickly touching up frizzy baby hairs. It heats up quickly and is good for getting fine hair close to the scalp. It’s small so you can leave it out on the counter without causing a lot of clutter.

DO NOT USE ANY... OIL!!! It'll still work just not as well. It works GREAT on my man's beard. GIRLS if you want to just straighten your bangs it works GREAT!!! I haven't tried to straighten all of my hair but I'm sure it would work just fine.

Got this as a present for the hubby and he absolutely loves it! I've always offered to flat iron his bears and he would always freak out and tell me no. With this he isn't scared of burning himself and product does do as it states

Bought it for my husband to straightened his bear, worked really well. It wasn't heavy at all and get warm fast. The thing I am so excited about is ceramic teeth, their length is perfect and do  not touch the face. Love it.

This was a small beard straightener. It got very hot to the touch, so much so that it burnt our hand even tapping it to see if it was warm. I have owned other brush straighteners and they did not do that! I returned!

Didn't even get to try it Took it out of the box placed it on the counter plugged it in turn it on the first click About 20 seconds later I hear a pop  No lights,no heat  Dont waste your money  Very disappointed

This beard straightener takes way too long to heat up to be able to straighten my hubby’s beard. I wish it worked better. It only works well if you constantly keep going over the beard for about 30 minutes.
Returned all it did was burn my hair and if you ever smelled burned hair not a good smell. And after burning the skin under my right sideburn and just bellow my lip I never wanted to use it again
Has 2 heat settings (LOW/HIGH) It could use an audible tone to signal when its at temperature, like other straighteners I’ve seen. The low profile is great for a beard that’s just over a 3 guard

reviews.t: My husband loves his beard straightner!
reviews.x: I bought him for this for valentines day and he was so excited to use it. I hate his beard cause it normally looks shaggy and unkept. This makes it smooth and shiny and it works fast.
Bought this as a Christmas gift for my husband and he loves it.  He mostly uses it for his beard but have used it for his head.  It take a minute to get hot but overall great product.
I got warm when you plugged it in and turned it on, other than that it was just an expensive hair brush.  used it for weeks and it had no effect on my beard. returned it.
i would rate this product a 7/10 bc it didnt really work super great unless you brushed it over and over again. for the money its alright but its not the BEST

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the device heats up quickly and is easy to use.
Many say it effectively straightens beards, making them look longer, smoother, and shinier.
Several reviewers note it works well for shorter beards and hair, with some finding it less effective for longer or thicker beards.
Some users mention burning themselves, particularly around the edges or mustache.
Multiple reviewers bought it as a gift for a husband or boyfriend who ended up liking it.
